project.name: synthetic-review-queue
project.description: A public-safe example for tracking queued assets through human and automated review.
project.maintainer_intent: Demonstrate queue state, review signal separation, and handoff completeness with synthetic assets.

decision_gate.next_action: Have a maintainer rate the queued synthetic assets before any automated recommendation is accepted.
known_unknowns: No queue item has a final human rating yet.

handoff.goal: Demonstrate a public-safe review queue handoff.
handoff.current_status: Three synthetic assets are queued with separate human and automated review signals.
handoff.next_action: Record maintainer ratings and compare them with automated notes.
known_unknowns: Final asset decisions are unknown until human review is complete.
